hyperedges.label: Gitignored .dev.vars failures leading to config standing rules
Per-isolate and render memoization from the optimization pass

nodes.label: Show-all-lyrics checkbox (revealHint)
nodes.rationale: Reuses the dev-hint mechanism gated on server-computed victory, no extra endpoint.

nodes.label: Daily song rotation (UTC midnight)
nodes.rationale: Same puzzle for everyone, Wordle-style; no replay with a different song.

nodes.label: Out of scope: 3D, team mode, accounts, D1
nodes.norm_label: out of scope: 3d, team mode, accounts, d1

nodes.label: Windows PowerShell gotchas installing graphify (2026-09-12)
nodes.rationale: Quoted paths need the & call operator; echo > writes UTF-16LE with BOM — use WriteAllText with BOM-less UTF8Encoding.

nodes.label: graphify extraction defects fixed by hand (2026-09-29)
nodes.norm_label: graphify extraction defects fixed by hand (2026-09-29)
nodes.rationale: Self-loop normalize(), dangling CSS import edges, ghost worker_src_similarity_wordpositions; npm run graph:update drops listed edges; read the health check before committing a rebuild.

nodes.label: NEAR_SCORE (40)
nodes.rationale: Pegged to warm tier so a warm/hot chip always lands somewhere.

nodes.label: SIMILARITY_TABLE_VERSION (3)
nodes.rationale: Bumped on any table shape/meaning change so old tables are ignored, not half-read.

nodes.label: KV binding shipped commented out; dev uses --var SIMILARITY_SAMPLE
nodes.norm_label: kv binding shipped commented out; dev uses --var similarity_sample
nodes.rationale: wrangler deploy validates namespace ids so a speculative binding breaks deploy; prefer wrangler dev --var in npm scripts over .dev.vars entries for dev-only switches.

nodes.label: Function words never count
nodes.rationale: They sit close to every word and would take most placements.

nodes.label: Normalization must stay in step
nodes.rationale: Changing normalize/tokenize invalidates all stored tables.

nodes.label: Numbers compared by value (numberHint)
nodes.rationale: Model has no digit tokens.

nodes.label: Hidden words addressed by position
nodes.rationale: IDs would reveal which blanks hide the same word.

nodes.label: Rank-based scoring (100-20*log10(rank))
nodes.rationale: A fixed cosine threshold means something different per hidden word; ranks normalize this.

nodes.label: Anti-cheat: Worker-only lyrics
nodes.rationale: Worker is the only code that sees unmasked lyrics; client only gets masked tokens and positions.

nodes.label: Config rules: gitignored file never manual; missing config names itself
nodes.norm_label: config rules: gitignored file never manual; missing config names itself
nodes.rationale: Missing worker/.dev.vars broke CI once and a dev machine once as an opaque DataError.

nodes.label: HMAC-signed round state
nodes.rationale: Keeps the Worker stateless while making forged 'already found' progress impossible.

nodes.label: Missing worker/.dev.vars bit twice (2026-09-13)
nodes.rationale: Second occurrence promoted to standing rules: gitignored config is never a manual step (ensure-dev-vars via predev:worker), and missing config names itself (STATE_SECRET middleware check).

nodes.label: A placeholder makes a feature look finished
nodes.norm_label: a placeholder makes a feature look finished
nodes.rationale: All observed scores came from SIMILARITY_SAMPLE; measure against the real model before tuning, and keep the measurement scripted.

nodes.label: Similarity too strict: rank-based scoring (2026-09-15)
nodes.rationale: Fixed cosine thresholds mean something different per word and function words hog slots; scores became ranks (100 - 20*log10(rank)), NEAR_SCORE 40, up to 16 placements, function words excluded.

nodes.label: songId in /api/round leaks the title
nodes.rationale: Catalog ids are slugified titles; fixing needs an opaque per-day round id touching the wire contract, roundStorage and e2e helpers — noted, not fixed.

nodes.label: STATE_SECRET var/secret binding conflict (2026-09-11)
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare rejects a var and a secret with one name; moved to .dev.vars, which broke CI because gitignored files are absent on fresh checkout.

nodes.label: Only numbers cross the wire
nodes.rationale: Never text, vectors, ranks or table slices reach the client.

nodes.label: Placement is display, not progress
nodes.rationale: Placement never enters signed state; a forged placement only fools the forger.

nodes.label: npm run deploy:check
nodes.rationale: Builds the deployed wrangler.toml before merge so a broken config is caught pre-merge.

nodes.label: CI deploy job
nodes.rationale: Runs only on push to main after tests pass.

nodes.label: VITE_API_BASE_URL build env
nodes.rationale: Pages and Worker are different origins, so the frontend needs the Worker's absolute URL.

nodes.label: Fetch failures silently swallowed in the UI (2026-09-11)
nodes.norm_label: fetch failures silently swallowed in the ui (2026-09-11)
nodes.rationale: Error state tracked but not rendered; static French messages, Réessayer button, error cleared on each guess; e2e tests use page.route().abort().

nodes.label: LRCLIB metadata isn't clean
nodes.rationale: trackName contained a unit-separator control char; displayed title/artist always come from catalog.ts; sanitize() strips control chars.

nodes.label: LRC markup leaked into guessable words (2026-09-14)
nodes.norm_label: lrc markup leaked into guessable words (2026-09-14)
nodes.rationale: Id tags ([ar:...] leaks the artist), word timestamps, section headers, instrumental filler; lines dropped outright not blanked; brackets are markup, parentheses (backing vocals) are sung. MIN_LYRIC_WORDS=20 counted after cleanup.

nodes.label: tokenize() letter class missed œ (cœur split)
nodes.norm_label: tokenize() letter class missed œ (cœur split)
nodes.rationale: LETTER_CLASS stopped at Latin-1; now includes œ, Œ, Ÿ and normalize() spells out œ/æ. Regression tests in tokenize/normalize tests.

nodes.label: resolveSong.ts split out for Node tooling
nodes.norm_label: resolvesong.ts split out for node tooling
nodes.rationale: Scripts under plain Node lack workers-types (caches.default); splitting resolution from caching is a real seam and keeps scripts type-checked.

nodes.label: LRCLIB /api/search instead of /api/get
nodes.rationale: /api/get needs exact track/artist match and 404s otherwise; /api/search is fuzzy and returns ranked candidates.

nodes.label: Debug mode (npm run dev:debug)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder scores can't judge hint quality; plays today's song against a real local-only KV table.

nodes.label: E2E dedicated ports (15173/18787/19229)
nodes.rationale: Never reuse a running server so e2e always tests this clone's code.

nodes.label: E2E from a worktree tested the main checkout's servers (2026-09-13)
nodes.norm_label: e2e from a worktree tested the main checkout's servers (2026-09-13)
nodes.rationale: reuseExistingServer let Playwright reuse another checkout's dev servers; fixed with dedicated ports (15173/18787/19229), no reuse, and configurable API_PROXY_TARGET.

nodes.label: Playwright webServer raced Wrangler cold start (2026-09-11)
nodes.norm_label: playwright webserver raced wrangler cold start (2026-09-11)
nodes.rationale: One webServer entry per port; a combined command with one URL only proves the fastest process is up.

nodes.label: Google Fonts preconnect link
nodes.rationale: Font request starts as soon as HTML is parsed.

nodes.label: Continuous improvement loop
nodes.rationale: Log gotchas in LEARNINGS.md; promote recurring mistakes to rules in CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Performance rules (memoize per isolate, no re-render on keystroke)
nodes.norm_label: performance rules (memoize per isolate, no re-render on keystroke)
nodes.rationale: Everything slow was correct work repeated for an unchanged value; pin with tests counting work, never timings.

nodes.label: One-time Cloudflare account setup for CI deploy
nodes.norm_label: one-time cloudflare account setup for ci deploy
nodes.rationale: Pages project and workers.dev subdomain must exist before non-interactive wrangler-action can succeed; three independent one-time steps.

nodes.label: CORS preflight without Access-Control-Max-Age
nodes.rationale: Cross-origin POST /api/guess preflighted on most guesses; cors({ maxAge: 86400 }) makes it once per session.

nodes.label: Pages and Worker on different origins: VITE_API_BASE_URL required (2026-09-12)
nodes.norm_label: pages and worker on different origins: vite_api_base_url required (2026-09-12)
nodes.rationale: Unset VITE_API_BASE_URL makes the build call relative /api on the Pages origin with no Worker; set in deploy job, pinned by deploy-workflow.test.ts.

nodes.label: Deploy failing: 'Not logged in', not Node 20 deprecation (2026-09-11)
nodes.norm_label: deploy failing: 'not logged in', not node 20 deprecation (2026-09-11)
nodes.rationale: Read past a deprecation warning next to the real error; missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/ACCOUNT_ID secrets can't be fixed by workflow edits.

nodes.label: Emergency fallback song (EMERGENCY_FALLBACK_SONG)
nodes.rationale: Served when every catalog entry fails to resolve (e.g. LRCLIB blocked); not in catalog.ts, so specs looking up songId fail.

nodes.label: Float32 round-trips need toBeCloseTo
nodes.rationale: 0.6 in a Float32Array reads back as 0.6000000238...; element-wise toBeCloseTo in embeddings tests.

nodes.label: Google Fonts @import moved to <link> + preconnect
nodes.rationale: An @import starts a full round trip late; a <link> with preconnect to both origins loads earlier.

nodes.label: Playwright hasText is a substring match (2026-09-13)
nodes.norm_label: playwright hastext is a substring match (2026-09-13)
nodes.rationale: Words from the day's song are effectively random input; locators must match exactly (anchored RegExp).

nodes.label: Isolate memos need reset*() in beforeEach
nodes.norm_label: isolate memos need reset*() in beforeeach
nodes.rationale: An isolate-level cache silently answers a question a test meant to ask for real; add the reset in the same commit as the cache.

nodes.label: Typing re-rendered every lyrics token
nodes.rationale: 126 token renders for three keystrokes; useMemo on read inputs plus memo() components takes it to zero.

nodes.label: LRCLIB requires a client identifier header
nodes.norm_label: lrclib requires a client identifier header
nodes.rationale: Per LRCLIB docs every request identifies the app; lrclib.ts sends Lrclib-Client.

nodes.label: Optimization pass: repeated work, three caches (2026-09-15)
nodes.norm_label: optimization pass: repeated work, three caches (2026-09-15)
nodes.rationale: Almost none of the cost was where it looked; every problem was correct work repeated for an unchanged value. Pinned by tests counting work, never timings.

nodes.label: Sandbox without LRCLIB access fails e2e (2026-09-28)
nodes.norm_label: sandbox without lrclib access fails e2e (2026-09-28)
nodes.rationale: Before blaming a change for an e2e failure in a restricted environment, run the same specs on the base commit first; a test depending on the day's real song is only as reliable as the network path to LRCLIB.

nodes.label: Run scripts via tsx, not Node type stripping
nodes.norm_label: run scripts via tsx, not node type stripping
nodes.rationale: Node's native stripping needs explicit .ts import extensions, which the codebase doesn't use.

nodes.label: Wrangler .wrangler/ state is version-specific
nodes.rationale: Switching Wrangler versions broke workerd (_cf_ALARM column mismatch); rm -rf .wrangler fixes it; pnpm resolves different versions than npm ci.
